detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Operational causal memory requires internal states to maintain persistent, predictive correlations with future environmental states. Effective memory emerges when environmental coupling allows for coarse-grained reconstruction of relevant historical dynamics, distinct from simple state persistence.
detail.reason: Incorporating structural correlations and filter-theoretic approaches to refine memory definitions.
